top_signals.title: Streetcar that survived atomic bomb now used for tours in Hiroshima
top_signals.summary: The tour that showcases the city's reconstruction, uses Hiroshima Electric Railway's streetcar No. 653, which was damaged in the blast on Aug. 6, 1945.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
